title: Reading, harmony and six years of study
summary: He learned strictly by reading, wants to be an all-round musician, studied harmony on his own, and studied about six years with Corzell.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
